description: Idempotent upsert of a vulnerability finding. Re-submitting the same idempotency_key updates the existing row (COALESCE: null fields do not overwrite existing values).

idempotency_key.description: Unique key that identifies this finding event. Convention: 'ingest-<cve_id>-<asset_name>'. Must be stable across retries.

cve_id.description: CVE identifier in the form CVE-YYYY-NNNNN.

asset_id.description: UUID of the affected asset from the assets table.

proposed_severity.description: Severity proposed by the ingest/correlation agent before governance approval.

approved_severity.description: Severity confirmed by the governance agent.

exploitability_rationale.description: One-paragraph rationale explaining the exploitability assessment.

sla_due_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime by which remediation must complete.

owner_team.description: Slug of the team responsible for remediation.

decision_state.description: Governance decision state for this finding.
